column1: # Real vivutruyen2.net pages, unedited, fetched directly — this host answers
# a plain request, so no Worker was needed. One row per captured page.
# capture_url is where the bytes came from; app_url is the URL the app uses.
# They are the same here: one host serves the catalogue, and www. 301s to the
# https apex rather than serving a second copy of it.
# columns: site  file  capture_url  app_url  kind  completed  chapters  max_page
# `chapters` is the DISTINCT chapter links inside the first .list and
# `max_page` is always 1 — this host never paginates a chapter list (every
# captured novel is 4–8 chapters, all on the novel page). Both measured at
# capture time with bs4/lxml, NOT with this app's parser, so the tests
# cross-check the two readings rather than echoing one back.
# The 116 were picked across the post sitemaps (oldest catalogue through
# newest) plus a handful of must-have shapes (suffixed chapter urls, the
# mixed full-chuong-N list, the two novels that are not Hoàn thành) rather
